facts.text: Oberstrass joined the city of Zurich in 1893, ending its status as an independent municipality.
The Rigiblick funicular, one of only two in Zurich, climbs the hill of Oberstrass to the historic Rigiblick restaurant.
After serving as a 1901 restaurant, the Rigiblick building reopened as Theater Rigiblick in 1984, preserving its historic charm.
In 1925, Oberstrass citizens founded the Zunft zu Oberstrass, signing the charter in the Lindensaal with the motto “Oberstrass zur Ehr, Zürich zur Wehr!”.
A watchtower called the Krattenturm guarded Oberstrass’s outer Limmat valley until its destruction in 1444 during the Old Zürich War.
The first written record of Oberstrass dates to 1376, when the street then known as “obere Strass” linked the Neumarkttor to Winterthur.
